title: Effective C++
summary: It gives the main rules for the correct use of C++. The canon of this site uses the 3rd edition (2005), ISBN 9780321334879.

title: Effective Java
summary: It gives the main rules for the correct use of Java. The canon of this site uses the 3rd edition (2018), ISBN 9780134685991.

title: Effective Modern C++
summary: It gives the rules for the features of C++11 and C++14. The canon of this site uses the first edition (2014), ISBN 9781491903995.
